payload.comparison_population: patients without acute inflammatory or infectious CNS diseases
payload.symptoms: focal seizures with impaired consciousness, status epilepticus, EEG abnormalities, epileptogenic lesions
payload.supporting_quote: CSF lactate was elevated in 34 patients (22.5%) and showed a significant association with focal seizures with impaired consciousness, status epilepticus, the presence of EEG abnormalities in general and epileptiform potentials in particular, as well as epileptogenic lesions on cerebral imaging.

payload.symptoms: after epileptic seizures, especially longer seizures
payload.supporting_quote: elevated lactate levels are commonly seen after epileptic seizures and depend on seizure duration.
Lactate levels in the hippocampus were also increased in this seizure model, suggesting elevated LDH enzymatic activities.
